def run(name,cols_fn,starts):
    best=None
    for st in starts:
        def f(p):
            B=cols_fn(p)
            w,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,S,rcond=None)
            return S-B@w
        try:
            r=least_squares(f,st)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, np.mean(best.fun**2)/np.var(S), np.round(best.x,4))
